description: A certificate of lawful development is sought to confirm that the first-floor staffing area has been continuously used as a seating area for the restaurant in breach of condition 3 of planning permission (2001/4678). Evidence is provided in the form of Business rates previous customer's statements and a general survey. Permission was granted for the use of upper storey for Staff area and customer toilets. The staff did not use this area and was later made into a store. Due to demand for more seating spaces and facilities for private functions the upper Floor was changed into a seating area in 2009. It has been used as a overflow seating area and for special private functions to date.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The local planning authority, based on the evidence submitted, is not satisfied that the use was subsisting during a period of ten years prior to the Breach of Condition Notice dated 20.11.2023.

Reason : 2 - Informative: It is brought to your attention that, while the Application Form states that the first floor area was originally approved as a staff room and customer toilets before being converted into a seating area in 2009, the sworn affidavit submitted by the business owner asserts that the first floor has operated as customer seating continuously since the restaurant opened in 2002. These two accounts are inconsistent with one another. As consistency and accuracy of the evidence are essential to the assessment of a Certificate of Lawfulness, this discrepancy reduces the weight that can be afforded to the sworn affidavit and diminishes its reliability as supporting evidence.
